name: ableton
description: Drive Ableton Live 11 from Claude Code — tracks, clips, MIDI notes, devices, mixer, automation, arrangement, scenes, transport, and preset generation (Wavetable, Simpler, and rack macro names/colors/defaults, macro→parameter mappings, and chain zones) over a bundled MCP server. Includes a guided /ableton:setup and best-practice workflow commands.

author.name: Ryan Robson and Robworks Software LLC
